name: Dream House
tagline: Turns a rough floor-plan sketch into a furnished, editable 3D interior in minutes.
problem: Interior designers spend hours turning 2D floor plans into 3D visualizations, and doing it requires CAD or 3D-modelling skills.
solution: An image model cleans a sketched plan into a formal layout; a segmentation model extracts furniture positions and sizes, a floor-plan model detects walls, and each piece is matched to a generated 3D asset and rendered with the walls in a game engine.
demo_moment: Team-described: sketch a floor plan, adjust the cleaned layout, and press a button to get a furnished 3D room.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Took second place overall among 124 submissions.
Chains several vision and generative models; the team tried other detection approaches before settling on a hybrid that worked reliably.
Sketch in, 3D room out is a before-and-after that needs no explanation.

lessons: When one model is unreliable, combine specialised models per sub-task and show the end-to-end result.
